title: Returned Payments on the Installment Payment Plans
content:
**Reversal.** On the **Installment Payment Plans**, a returned payment reverses the original payment for its full amount on the date the bank return posts, and the charges it had paid become unpaid again.

**Returned-payment fee.** An NSF fee is charged only for a returned payment whose bank return reason is one that carries the fee (insufficient funds, account closed, stop payment by payer). Only one NSF fee is charged per returned payment. The fee is the plan's NSF fee; returns coded bank error or unauthorized debit carry no fee.

**Returned automatic drafts.** When the returned automatic drafts on a Monthly EFT or Monthly Card Autopay plan in its current term (counted by posting date, drafts made through automatic bank draft or card autopay) reach the plan's returned-draft count, the recurring authorization is revoked and the plan becomes the Cardinal Point Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan.

**Customer revocation — base clause, no longer in force as written.** The base sentence "a customer may also revoke a recurring authorization at any time; the plan then becomes the Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan for its remaining installments" is no longer in force; it is superseded by the current basis: when the named insured of an Owner Auto Policy term billed by automatic draft asks to stop the drafts while at least one installment has been invoiced and two or more are not yet invoiced, and neither the installment invoice that the payment most recently returned on it had paid nor its next installment invoice, if already issued, has two or more payments posted against it (a payment recorded against an invoice not counting when it is the returned payment itself or a makeup referencing it), and the owner term backs at most one certificate, and only then, the revocation is recorded with the move that schedule sets, once its waits are met; any other customer may revoke a recurring authorization at any time, the plan then becoming the Cardinal Point Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan for its remaining installments.

**Down payment.** A returned down payment closes the plan and voids the term.

| Return reason (hypothetical return) | NSF fee |
|---|---|
| insufficient funds | 25.00 on every plan |
| account closed | 25.00 |
| stop payment by payer | 25.00 |
| bank error | none |
| unauthorized debit | none |

Evidence: the return reason and the returned payment as the ledger records them; an NSF fee already linked to that returned payment bars a second one.

superseded_clauses: A customer may also revoke a recurring authorization at any time; the plan then becomes the Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan for its remaining installments.
